license.content: 中国神话（《淮南子》《山海经》《楚辞》，公有领域）的儿童复述，旁白自写；底图、配乐为 AI 原创生成，音效代码合成

music.title: Houyi Shoots the Suns
music.author: Galanty
music.attribution: Houyi Shoots the Suns — Galanty, original score generated with Lyria 3 Pro and edited with code-synthesized sound design (CC0 1.0)
music.modifications: Generated with Google Lyria 3 Pro (lyria-3-pro-preview) from original prompts (one full-length score and one opening cue); cut to the S114 timeline by tools/production/houyi-20261013/music_build.py (opening cue hit on the title, hero brass on Hou Yi's entrance, war-drum section under the volley, about 2 s of silence after the last arrow, gentle sections afterwards; 0.35 s equal-power crossfades on hard cuts, 260 Hz dip for the narrator), plus NumPy-synthesized sound effects (bowstring, arrow whistle, hit chime, gong, taiko, pops, slide whistle, crackle, rain, heat, wind, birdsong; no third-party samples), then encoded to 48 kbps MP3, 48 kHz stereo (library size budget). Timed to sample S114; other films will not hit its accents.

note: 给 4～9 岁小朋友的中国神话。旁白为预先生成的 Gemini 云端配音（旁白 Kore，后羿、金乌、村民各用一种音色；随包旁白种子，播放不联网）；改旁白文字后新句需要本机配音整片重配。底图（AI 生成）以 data URI 内联在幕代码里，同一张图只内联一次。配乐 Houyi Shoots the Suns（CC0，随包曲库 library:original-houyi）按本片逐字时间轴剪辑并合成音效：太阳倒数、每一箭的鼓与“锵”、最后一箭后的留白都对在本片旁白上，改节奏或换曲后不再对齐。卡点词都在各幕参数里（如 volley 幕的 counts）。正文约 119.9 秒，导出时接约 4.9 秒品牌片尾
